newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Salomon cuts Xerox '97 EPS by $.05.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Salomon cuts Xerox '97 EPS by $.05.

text.p: - Salomon Brothers Inc Jonathan Rosenzweig cut his earnings per share estimates for Xerox for 1997 and 1998 by $0.05 to reflect adverse impact of foreign exchange.
- Salomon continues to rate Xerox a "strong buy" based on the strength of its underlying business.

- "Our adjustment to earnings today reflects a weakening in the Mark and Franc during the last few months, offset by a strengthening in the Pound and certain other factors," Salomon analyst Rosenzweig said."
